# Modern Quilt Designer 0.11.0 Preview

The primary workspace has been structurally redesigned around the approved Phase 2 desktop concept.

- Full-width drawing/editing toolbar and a compact project header.
- Denser block library, larger central quilt workspace, readable rulers and bottom workspace navigation.
- Fabric tools on the right; wide screens show fabrics, properties and the quilt together.
- Project, Layout and Properties tabs, plus a live notebook/summary preview that opens the same editable notes.
- Resizable and collapsible side docks with saved local widths, coordinated light/dark colors and a quick appearance switch in the status bar.

Existing exact geometry, custom blocks, generators, project files, Undo/Redo, cutting and export workflows are retained. Dock preferences do not change saved quilt geometry. The notebook preview reflows for readability; full Notes and PDF exports keep the saved print layout.

To update, save your work, open **Settings → About & Updates**, choose **Preview / Development**, then **Check for updates → Download & install**. After restarting, choose **Restore design** to resume the open quilt. Installers are public; source remains private.

This remains a development preview. Existing construction and generator limits still apply. Fixed docks can resize and collapse; floating panels, multiple layout variants and 3D views are not included.
